PARAMETER_VALUE: source_timestamp DESC, source_partition DESC, source_offset DESC

SELECT
    event_key,
    object_key,
    etag,
    MAX(size) AS size,
    MAX(event_time) AS event_time
FROM lnd.gamma_object_events
GROUP BY
    event_key,
    object_key,
    etag
source_timestamp DESC, source_object DESC, source_row DESC
